trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all regions with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

**Rollback**
- Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west.
- Verified: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and post-rollback health. On-call should root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy.

transcript.content: I'll start by checking the current status and deployment history of checkout-api to identify the most recent healthy release.

transcript.content: The rollback hit a partial failure after us-east. Let me check the current state of the regions.

transcript.content: us-east is now on v2.3.0, but us-west and eu-west still run v2.3.1. Retrying the rollback to complete the remaining regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: us-east rolled back to v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. Retry rollback for remaining regions — but the rollback tool targets all regions. Retry rollback; it should handle already-rolled-back us-east. Let me retry.

transcript.content: The rollback completed across all regions. Verifying the service is now healthy.
transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback complete. Verify health, then open incident.

transcript.content: All regions are on v2.3.0, healthy with a 0.2% error rate. Now opening the SEV2 incident.
